protocol.cold: One new helper/pipeline per request; includes creation, input IPC, decode, selected I420 IPC, exact comparisons, EOS and final diagnostics
protocol.resident: One new session per trial, one untimed complete warmup request, then sequential timed requests; each returns before next submission; creation/warmup/close separately recorded
protocol.host: Includes input validation/serialization and byte-for-byte prefix check; appends cached prediction AUs and IDR fence
protocol.preencoded: Uses preloaded frozen access units; input serialization excluded
protocol.fence: One extra cached constant128 IDR per request; counted in bytes/pictures; previous fence discarded on next request, final fence drained at sole EOS
protocol.shared: Same AU protocol, geometry, bytes, selections and exact full-returned-I420 checks in cold and resident modes; order rotates by repeat
protocol.excluded: Compilation, fixture/reference generation, file loading, initial artifact/source audits, network and report writes
protocol.limits: Fixed fields/shape, independent IDR jobs, fresh input uploads each request. No CUDA/concurrent baseline, resident camera references, or zero-copy output.
